title: Q4 Cohort Release Map: Private Instance Activation & Gating Playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create an executable Q4 release map and gating playbook for private/VPC/on-prem customer cohorts. Scope covers tranche definitions, minimal acceptance criteria per cohort, interoperability checks (networking, KMS, audit logging), upgrade window constraints, capacity commitment signals for Dedicated vs Private, and a coordinated ops runbook for rollbacks and hotfixes. Deliverables: a cohort-by-cohort schedule, pre-flight checklist for SEs, a canary plan for three pilot customers, and a monitoring dashboard spec for rollout signals. This ticket synthesizes inputs from Sales/Solutions, Security, and Infra and prepares the work package for the engineering sprint that will implement rollout tooling and compatibility gates.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort map with explicit activation windows and risk tier for all Q4 customers
Pre-flight checklist documented and validated with Solutions Engineering
Canary plan executed with 3 pilot customers and rollback path < 2 hours
Interoperability matrix validated for KMS, VPC peering, and on-prem network egress
SLO/observability thresholds defined and wired into Console dashboards
Operations runbook (step-by-step) published and validated in a dry-run during the staging wave
checklist: Draft pre-flight checklist and security questionnaire
Align capacity commitments with Dedicated team
Define monitoring signals and alert thresholds
Prepare SE-facing activation playbook and customer comms templates
Execute engineering spike to validate upgrade path for model bundles
Schedule dry-run with internal staging customers
